shortDescription: GitHub-style user profile overview view with repositories and contribution activity.
fullDescription: Renders the user-profile-overview view in its default state with a dark profile header, tab navigation, left profile column, popular repositories grid, yearly contribution heatmap, and contribution activity section. The view accepts controlled or uncontrolled props for selectedTab, selectedYear, searchValue, user data, repositories, achievements, contribution months, and contribution grid so visible controls remain interactive while preserving the planned state contract.
